info: A redox reaction is a chemical reaction in which oxidation and reduction occur at the same time. In the reaction between copper(II) oxide and hydrogen, black copper(II) oxide is heated while hydrogen gas passes over it. Copper(II) oxide is reduced to copper because oxygen is removed from it. Hydrogen is oxidized because it combines with oxygen to form water. The reaction is CuO + H2 → Cu + H2O. The formation of reddish-brown copper and water shows that new substances have been produced.
